]);
function getCard(id){return CARDS.find(card=>card.id===Number(id));}

const ARCANA_IDS = Object.freeze(Array.from({length:22},(_,i)=>i));
function validRandom(random){const n=random();if(!Number.isFinite(n)||n<0||n>=1)throw Error('Invalid random number');return n;}
function shuffledIds(ids=ARCANA_IDS,random=Math.random){
  if(!Array.isArray(ids)||new Set(ids).size!==ids.length)throw Error('Invalid deck');
  const deck=[...ids];
  for(let i=deck.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(validRandom(random)*(i+1));[deck[i],deck[j]]=[deck[j],deck[i]];}
  return deck;
}
function drawFromSlots(shuffledDeck,slots,random=Math.random){
  if(new Set(slots).size!==slots.length)throw Error('Duplicate slot');
  return slots.map(slot=>{
    if(!Number.isInteger(slot)||slot<0||slot>=shuffledDeck.length)throw Error('Invalid slot');
    return {id:shuffledDeck[slot],orientation:validRandom(random)<0.5?'upright':'reversed'};
  });
}
function dateKeyLocal(date=new Date()){
  const p=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${p(date.getMonth()+1)}-${p(date.getDate())}`;
}
function seededRng(seed){let x=seed>>>0;return ()=>{x=(x+0x6d2b79f5)|0;let t=Math.imul(x^(x>>>15),1|x);t^=t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),61|t);return ((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296;}}
function getDailyDraw(localDate=new Date()){
  const dateKey=dateKeyLocal(localDate);
  let seed=2166136261;for(const ch of dateKey){seed^=ch.charCodeAt(0);seed=Math.imul(seed,16777619);}
  const rand=seededRng(seed);
  const deck=shuffledIds(ARCANA_IDS,rand);
  return {dateKey,cards:drawFromSlots(deck,[0],rand)};
}
function createRitual(spreadType,question=''){
  if(!['daily','single','three'].includes(spreadType))throw Error('Invalid spread');
  return {spreadType,question:question.trim(),phase:'shuffle',deck:[],picks:[],slots:[],revealed:false};
}
function reduceRitual(state,action){
  switch(action.type){
    case 'SHUFFLE': if(state.phase!=='shuffle')return state; return {...state,phase:'cut',deck:[...action.deck]};
    case 'CUT': if(state.phase!=='cut')return state;{
      const n=state.deck.length;if(!n)return state;const at=((action.at%n)+n)%n;
      return {...state,phase:'fan',deck:[...state.deck.slice(at),...state.deck.slice(0,at)]};
    }
    case 'PICK': if(state.phase!=='fan'||state.slots.includes(action.slot)||state.picks.length>=(state.spreadType==='three'?3:1)||!Number.isInteger(action.slot)||action.slot<0||action.slot>=state.deck.length)return state;
      return {...state,phase:'reveal',revealed:false,slots:[...state.slots,action.slot],picks:[...state.picks,{id:state.deck[action.slot],orientation:action.orientation}]};
    case 'REVEAL': return state.phase==='reveal'?{...state,revealed:true}:state;
    case 'NEXT': if(state.phase!=='reveal'||!state.revealed)return state;return {...state,phase:state.picks.length>=(state.spreadType==='three'?3:1)?'result':'fan',revealed:false};
    default: return state;
  }
}
function cryptoRandom(){
  if(typeof crypto!=='undefined'&&crypto.getRandomValues){const a=new Uint32Array(1);crypto.getRandomValues(a);return a[0]/4294967296;}
  return Math.random();
}

const JOURNAL_KEY='cthulhu-tarot:journal:v1';
const SETTINGS_KEY='cthulhu-tarot:settings:v1';
const canBeEntry=e=>e&&typeof e.entryId==='string'&&typeof e.createdAt==='string'&&['daily','single','three'].includes(e.spreadType)&&typeof e.question==='string'&&Array.isArray(e.cards)&&e.cards.length>=1&&e.cards.length<=3&&e.cards.every(c=>Number.isInteger(c.id)&&c.id>=0&&c.id<22&&typeof c.position==='string'&&['upright','reversed'].includes(c.orientation));
function loadJournal(storage){
  try{const raw=storage.getItem(JOURNAL_KEY);if(!raw)return {entries:[]};const data=JSON.parse(raw);
    if(data.version!==1||!Array.isArray(data.entries)||!data.entries.every(canBeEntry))return {entries:[],warning:'旧记录格式无法识别；数据未被覆盖。'};
    return {entries:data.entries.slice(0,100)};
  }catch{return {entries:[],warning:'无法读取本地调查日志（浏览器可能限制了存储）。'};}
}
function write(storage,entries){
  try{storage.setItem(JOURNAL_KEY,JSON.stringify({version:1,entries}));return {ok:true};}
  catch{return {ok:false,warning:'无法写入本地存储，请检查隐私模式或存储空间。本次结果仍可在当前页面查看。'};}
}
function saveEntry(storage,entry){
  if(!canBeEntry(entry))return {ok:false,warning:'记录字段无效，未保存。'};
  const previous=loadJournal(storage);if(previous.warning)return {ok:false,warning:previous.warning};
  return write(storage,[entry,...previous.entries.filter(e=>e.entryId!==entry.entryId)].slice(0,100));
}
function deleteEntry(storage,id){const previous=loadJournal(storage);return previous.warning?{ok:false,warning:previous.warning}:write(storage,previous.entries.filter(e=>e.entryId!==id));}
function clearJournal(storage){return write(storage,[]);}
function loadPreferences(storage){try{const raw=storage.getItem(SETTINGS_KEY);const obj=raw?JSON.parse(raw):{};return {reducedMotion:obj.reducedMotion===true,soundEnabled:false};}catch{return {reducedMotion:false,soundEnabled:false};}}
function savePreferences(storage,prefs){try{storage.setItem(SETTINGS_KEY,JSON.stringify({reducedMotion:!!prefs.reducedMotion,soundEnabled:false}));return true;}catch{return false;}}




const root=document.getElementById('app');

const htmlName=card=>`${escapeHtml(card.titleZh)} · ${escapeHtml(card.titleEn)}`;

function home(){root.innerHTML=`

function codex(){root.innerHTML=`<div class="codex-header">${sectionIntro('THE FORBIDDEN CODEX / 22 ARCHIVES','禁忌之书','每张牌都来自经典的克苏鲁神话线索。请选择一张，阅读真实的原著依据与属于它的艺术演绎。')}<label class="smallcap" style="width:min(100%,300px)">检索档案<input class="search-input" placeholder="牌名 / 古神 / 小说" id="codexSearch" value="${escapeHtml(searchQuery)}" aria-label="检索卡牌"/></label></div><div class="stats-strip"><span>馆藏 <b id="codexCount">22</b> / 22</span><span>体系 <b>大阿卡纳</b></span><span>状态 <b>私人预览 · 候选美术</b></span></div><div class="hairline"></div><div class="codex-grid" id="codexGrid"></div>`;updateSearch(searchQuery);root.querySelector('#codexSearch').addEventListener('input',e=>updateSearch(e.target.value));}

function ritualStart(){ritual=null;recorded=false;saveWarning='';root.innerHTML=sectionIntro('THE RITUAL / ENTER THE UNKNOWN','命运仪式','请先选择牌阵。你可以提出一个问题，也可以让卡牌自由指引思绪。')+`<div class="ritual-screen"><div class="ritual-modes">${[['daily','☼','每日一牌','每天在本机日期内固定的一张启示'],['single','✧','单牌提问','针对一个具体问题进行抽取'],['three','⚝','三牌牌阵','以过去、现在、未来展开叙事']].map(([id,icon,name,desc])=>`<button type="button" class="mode-card ${chosenSpread===id?'chosen':''}" data-spread="${id}" aria-pressed="${chosenSpread===id}"><span class="mode-icon">${icon}</span><strong>${name}</strong><small>${desc}</small></button>`).join('')}</div><label class="question-label" for="question">写下你的疑问 <span class="muted">/ 可留空</span></label><textarea class="question-input" id="question" maxlength="500" placeholder="例如：我正在面对怎样的选择？">${escapeHtml(draftQuestion)}</textarea><div class="btn-row"><button class="btn wide" id="enterRitual">进入仪式 <span>↗</span></button></div><p class="note">目前暂未连接 DeepSeek，不会上传任何问题。牌面、图鉴与本地日志可以完整使用。</p></div>`;
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-spread]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{chosenSpread=btn.dataset.spread;draftQuestion=root.querySelector('#question').value;ritualStart();}));

}
function progress(active){return `<div class="progress-track" aria-label="仪式步骤">${STAGES.map((s,i)=>`<span class="${i===active?'here':''}">${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')} ${s}</span>`).join('')}</div>`;}
function stageTop(text,desc,index){return progress(index)+`<div class="eyebrow">${SPREAD_LABELS[ritual.spreadType]} / ${ritual.picks.length} ${ritual.spreadType==='three'?'/ 3':''}</div><h2 class="stage-heading">${text}</h2><p class="stage-desc">${desc}</p>`;}
function fan(){const used=new Set(ritual.slots);const slots=Array.from({length:11},(_,i)=>i);return `<div class="fan-scroll" role="group" aria-label="展开的卡背，选择卡牌">${slots.map(i=>`<button class="fan-card" style="--rot:${(i-5)*2.1}deg;z-index:${i+1}" data-slot="${i}" aria-label="选择第${i+1}个牌位" ${used.has(i)?'disabled':''}>${backImg()}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;}
function renderRitual(){if(!ritual){ritualStart();return;}
  const phase=ritual.phase;
  const inner=phase==='shuffle'?stageTop('聆听未写下的命运','洗牌会随机重排全部22张大阿卡纳，翻牌前不会提前展示正面。',1)+`<div class="ritual-altar"><div class="altar-card" id="shuffleAnim" aria-label="塔罗牌背"></div></div><button class="btn wide" id="shuffleBtn">洗牌</button>`:

  phase==='fan'?stageTop('选取命运之牌',`请点击你想选择的卡背。${ritual.spreadType==='three'?'三张牌将依次揭开过去、现在与未来。':''}`,3)+`<p class="picked-progress">${ritual.picks.length?'已抽取 '+ritual.picks.length+' 张 · ':''} ${ritual.spreadType==='three'?'还需 '+(3-ritual.picks.length)+' 张':'请选择一张'}</p>${fan()}<p class="note">手机上可以横向滑动牌组，点击任意尚未选择的牌背。</p>`:
  phase==='dailyReady'?stageTop('今日之牌','每天在此设备的本地日期内固定一张卡牌。',3)+`<div class="ritual-altar"><div class="altar-card"></div></div><button class="btn" id="dailyDraw">抽取今日之牌</button>`:
  phase==='reveal'?renderReveal():renderResult();
  root.innerHTML=`<section class="page-intro ritual-screen" style="padding-bottom:0"><div class="eyebrow">THE RITUAL / THE VEIL</div></section><div class="ritual-screen"><section class="ritual-stage">${inner}</section><div class="hairline"></div><div style="text-align:center"><button class="text-btn" id="resetRitual">← 放弃本次仪式，重新选择</button></div></div>`;
  bindRitual();}
function renderReveal(){const p=ritual.picks.at(-1),card=getCard(p.id),idx=ritual.picks.length-1;return stageTop(ritual.revealed?'面纱已经揭开':'揭示隐藏的符号',`第 ${idx+1} 张 / ${positions[ritual.spreadType][idx]} · ${ritual.revealed?card.titleZh:'请亲自翻开牌背'}`,4)+`<div class="reveal-area"><div class="flip-card ${ritual.revealed?'flipped':''}" id="flippingCard" aria-label="${ritual.revealed?htmlName(card):'未翻开的卡牌'}"><div class="flip-inner"><div class="flip-side flip-back">${backImg()}</div><div class="flip-side flip-front ${p.orientation==='reversed'?'is-reversed':''}">${ritual.revealed?cardImg(card,{loading:'loading="eager"'}):''}</div></div></div></div><p class="status-chip">${ritual.revealed?`${card.titleZh} · ${p.orientation==='upright'?'正位':'逆位'}`:'等待翻牌'}</p><div class="btn-row" style="justify-content:center">${ritual.revealed?`<button class="btn" id="nextDraw">${ritual.picks.length===(ritual.spreadType==='three'?3:1)?'查看命运解读':'继续抽取'} →</button>`:'<button class="btn" id="revealBtn">翻开此牌</button>'}</div>`;}
function summaryCard(p,i){const c=getCard(p.id);return `<article class="reading-card">${cardImg(c,{className:p.orientation==='reversed'?'reversed':''})}<h3>${positions[ritual.spreadType][i]} · ${c.titleZh}</h3><p>${p.orientation==='upright'?'正位':'逆位'} / ${c.mythEntity}</p></article>`;}
function renderResult(){const request={question:ritual.question,spreadType:ritual.spreadType,cards:ritual.picks.map((p,i)=>({...p,position:positions[ritual.spreadType][i]}))};return `<div class="eyebrow">THE READING / ${SPREAD_LABELS[ritual.spreadType]}</div><h2 class="stage-heading">面纱之后的启示</h2><p class="stage-desc">${request.question?`你的问题：${escapeHtml(request.question)}`:'未填写问题 · 自由探索'}</p><div class="reading-cards" style="--n:${request.cards.length}">${request.cards.map(summaryCard).join('')}</div><div class="reading-panel"><h3>牌面线索</h3><p class="muted">以下仅展示预先校对的传统塔罗关键词，<strong>不是AI实时解读</strong>。</p><div class="reading-interpretations">${request.cards.map((p,i)=>{const c=getCard(p.id),k=p.orientation==='upright'?c.uprightKeywords:c.reversedKeywords;return `<article><strong>${p.position} · ${c.titleZh}（${p.orientation==='upright'?'正位':'逆位'}）</strong><p>${k.join(' · ')}</p></article>`;}).join('')}</div><div class="ai-offline" role="status"><strong>◇ AI 服务尚未配置</strong><p>DeepSeek 的“深渊神谕 + 现实解读”将在你日后通过安全后端配置API后开放。本次不发送问题、不会生成伪造的AI结果。</p></div><p class="note">${saveWarning?escapeHtml(saveWarning):'本次牌阵仅保存在当前设备的调查日志。抽牌是文学娱乐与自我反思，不用于确定性预言。'}</p></div><div class="btn-row" style="justify-content:center"><a class="outline-btn" href="#/journal">打开调查日志</a><button class="btn" id="restartAfter">开启新的仪式 →</button></div>`;}
function recordSession(){if(recorded)return;recorded=true;const request=ritual.picks.map((p,i)=>({id:p.id,orientation:p.orientation,position:positions[ritual.spreadType][i]}));const entry={entryId:typeof crypto.randomUUID==='function'?crypto.randomUUID():`${Date.now()}-${Math.round(Math.random()*1e6)}`,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),spreadType:ritual.spreadType,question:ritual.question,cards:request};const result=saveEntry(storage(),entry);saveWarning=result.ok?'':result.warning||'本次记录无法写入。';}
function bindRitual(){root.querySelector('#resetRitual')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{draftQuestion='';ritualStart();});
  root.querySelector('#shuffleBtn')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{const button=e.currentTarget;button.disabled=true;root.querySelector('#shuffleAnim')?.classList.add('shuffle-animation');const doIt=()=>{ritual=reduceRitual(ritual,{type:'SHUFFLE',deck:shuffledIds(ARCANA_IDS,cryptoRandom)});renderRitual();};reducedMotion()?doIt():setTimeout(doIt,580);});
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-cut]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{ritual=reduceRitual(ritual,{type:'CUT',at:Number(btn.dataset.cut)});renderRitual();}));
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-slot]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{ritual=reduceRitual(ritual,{type:'PICK',slot:Number(btn.dataset.slot),orientation:cryptoRandom()<0.5?'upright':'reversed'});renderRitual();}));
  root.querySelector('#dailyDraw')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const d=getDailyDraw();ritual={...ritual,phase:'reveal',picks:d.cards.map(c=>({...c})),slots:[0],revealed:false};renderRitual();});
  root.querySelector('#revealBtn')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.currentTarget.disabled=true;ritual=reduceRitual(ritual,{type:'REVEAL'});const p=ritual.picks.at(-1),c=getCard(p.id);const flip=root.querySelector('#flippingCard');flip.querySelector('.flip-front').innerHTML=cardImg(c,{loading:'loading="eager"'});requestAnimationFrame(()=>{flip.classList.add('flipped');flip.setAttribute('aria-label',htmlName(c));});const nextLabel=ritual.picks.length===(ritual.spreadType==='three'?3:1)?'查看命运解读':'继续抽取';const row=e.currentTarget.parentElement;e.currentTarget.remove();row.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<button class="btn" id="nextDraw">${nextLabel} →</button>`);root.querySelector('#nextDraw').addEventListener('click',onNext);root.querySelector('.status-chip').textContent=`${c.titleZh} · ${p.orientation==='upright'?'正位':'逆位'}`;});
  root.querySelector('#nextDraw')?.addEventListener('click',onNext);
  root.querySelector('#restartAfter')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{ritualStart();});
}
function onNext(){ritual=reduceRitual(ritual,{type:'NEXT'});if(ritual.phase==='result')recordSession();renderRitual();}
function journal(){const result=loadJournal(storage());const list=result.entries;root.innerHTML=sectionIntro('INVESTIGATION LOG / PERSONAL ARCHIVE','调查日志','每一次翻牌都留下一份卷宗。所有记录仅保存在你当前浏览器的本地存储中。')+`<div class="stats-strip"><span>已收录 <b>${list.length}</b> 条</span><span>不云端同步 · 可随时删除</span></div><div class="hairline"></div>${result.warning?`<div class="ai-offline">${escapeHtml(result.warning)}</div>`:''}<div class="journal-list">${list.length?list.map(entry=>`<article class="journal-item"><img src="${getCard(entry.cards[0].id).artFile}" alt="${getCard(entry.cards[0].id).titleZh}"/><div><span class="date">${new Date(entry.createdAt).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</span><h3>${SPREAD_LABELS[entry.spreadType]}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(entry.question||'自由探索')}</p><p>${entry.cards.map(p=>`${getCard(p.id).titleZh} · ${p.orientation==='upright'?'正位':'逆位'}`).join(' / ')}</p></div><div class="journal-actions"><button class="outline-btn small open-entry" data-id="${escapeHtml(entry.entryId)}">打开卷宗</button><button class="text-btn small delete-entry" data-id="${escapeHtml(entry.entryId)}">删除</button></div></article>`).join(''):empty('暂无调查记录。打开“开始占卜”，完成一次翻牌后将在这里看到记录。')}</div>${list.length?'<button id="clearAll" class="outline-btn small">清空所有记录</button>':''}`;
  root.querySelectorAll('.open-entry').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{location.hash=`#/journal/${encodeURIComponent(b.dataset.id)}`;}));
  root.querySelectorAll('.delete-entry').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const res=deleteEntry(storage(),b.dataset.id);res.ok?journal():toast(res.warning);}));
  root.querySelector('#clearAll')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(window.confirm('确定删除本机全部占卜记录吗？此操作不可撤销。')){const res=clearJournal(storage());res.ok?journal():toast(res.warning);}});
}

function journalDetail(id){
 const result=loadJournal(storage());const entry=result.entries.find(e=>e.entryId===id);
 if(!entry){root.innerHTML=sectionIntro('INVESTIGATION LOG','卷宗不存在','这份本地记录可能已经清除。')+'<a href="#/journal" class="outline-btn">返回调查日志</a>';return;}
 root.innerHTML=`<div class="detail-head"><a class="text-btn" href="#/journal">← 返回调查日志</a><span class="eyebrow">SAVED READING</span></div><div class="ritual-screen"><section class="page-intro"><div class="eyebrow">THE ARCHIVE / ${escapeHtml(entry.createdAt.slice(0,10))}</div><h2>已保存的牌阵</h2><p class="subtext">${SPREAD_LABELS[entry.spreadType]} · ${escapeHtml(entry.question||'自由探索')}</p></section><div class="reading-cards" style="--n:${entry.cards.length}">${entry.cards.map(p=>{const c=getCard(p.id);return `<article class="reading-card">${cardImg(c,{className:p.orientation==='reversed'?'reversed':''})}<h3>${escapeHtml(p.position)} · ${c.titleZh}</h3><p>${p.orientation==='upright'?'正位':'逆位'}</p></article>`;}).join('')}</div><div class="reading-panel"><h3>保留下来的线索</h3><div class="reading-interpretations">${entry.cards.map(p=>{const c=getCard(p.id);return `<article><strong>${escapeHtml(p.position)} · ${c.titleZh}</strong><p>${(p.orientation==='upright'?c.uprightKeywords:c.reversedKeywords).join(' · ')}</p></article>`;}).join('')}</div><div class="ai-offline"><strong>AI 服务尚未配置</strong><p>本卷宗仅保存抽牌结果，没有人工伪造的AI解释。</p></div></div></div>`;
}

function settings(){const s=prefs();root.innerHTML=sectionIntro('CONFIGURATION / YOUR DEVICE','设置与隐私','整个私人预览版不需要账号，尚未与AI服务器连接。你的问题只在当前设备参与抽牌和日志记录。')+`<div class="settings-list"><div class="setting-item"><div><h3>减少动态效果</h3><p>减少翻牌和洗牌动画；系统“减少动态效果”设置优先。</p></div><input class="toggle" id="reduceMotion" type="checkbox" aria-label="减少动态效果" ${s.reducedMotion?'checked':''}></div><div class="setting-item"><div><h3>声音</h3><p>默认关闭；音效功能在后续版本提供。</p></div><span class="tag">后续支持</span></div><div class="setting-item"><div><h3>智能解读</h3><p>DeepSeek API 尚未配置。将来通过服务端安全连接，不会要求把密钥输入网页。</p></div><span class="tag">尚未连接</span></div><div class="panel soft"><h3>隐私与使用声明</h3><p class="note">本预览版没有账户、广告跟踪或自动上传个人问题的功能；牌面与日志存在本机浏览器，清理数据时可能永久丢失。塔罗内容仅用于娱乐、文化欣赏和自我反思，不应被当作医疗、法律、财务或确定性预测依据。</p></div><div class="btn-row"><a class="outline-btn" href="#/">← 返回首页</a></div></div>`;
  root.querySelector('#reduceMotion').addEventListener('change',e=>{sessionPreferences={...s,reducedMotion:e.target.checked};const saved=savePreferences(storage(),sessionPreferences);applyMotion();toast(saved?'偏好已保存在本设备':'已在当前会话生效；浏览器未允许保存此偏好。');});
}
function showWelcome(){let seen=false;try{seen=storage().getItem('cthulhu-tarot:welcome-seen:v1')==='yes';}catch{}if(seen)return;
  overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="welcome-shade" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="welcomeTitle"><div class="welcome-box"><div class="symbol">✦ ◇ ✦</div><p class="eyebrow">A NOTICE FROM THE ARCHIVES</p><h2 id="welcomeTitle">踏入门槛之前</h2><p>这里收藏22张以洛夫克拉夫特作品为灵感的大阿卡纳。抽牌属于文学娱乐与自我反思，不是对未来的确定性预测。</p><p>本预览版<strong>不连接AI</strong>，你的问题和调查日志不会自动上传到服务器，仅存于本设备。</p><button class="btn" id="agreeWelcome">同意并进入 →</button></div></div>`;
  overlay.querySelector('#agreeWelcome').addEventListener('click',()=>{try{storage().setItem('cthulhu-tarot:welcome-seen:v1','yes');}catch{}overlay.replaceChildren();});
}
function route(){applyMotion();const parts=(location.hash||'#/').replace(/^#\/?/,'').split('/');const view=parts[0]||'home';linksActive();if(view==='codex'){parts.length>1?detail(parts[1]):codex();}else if(view==='ritual'){ritual?renderRitual():ritualStart();}else if(view==='journal'){parts.length>1?journalDetail(decodeURIComponent(parts[1])):journal();}else if(view==='settings'){settings();}else{home();}window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});}
window.addEventListener('hashchange',route);
root.addEventListener('error',e=>{if(e.target instanceof HTMLImageElement&&e.target.getAttribute('src')?.includes('/cards/')){e.target.outerHTML='<div class="missing-art" role="img" aria-label="图片暂时不可用">卡面加载失败<br>可重新打开档案</div>';}} ,true);
route();showWelcome();
</script></body></html>
